 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0030
 Ashley Duncan, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer

7-25-24
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every alleagtion contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
For its affirmative defenses, Defendant states as follows. First, the collision was caused in whole or in part by
Plaintiff's own negligence, including failure to keep a proper lookout, failure to yield the rihgt of way, and failure to
maintain a single lane of travel. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must
be reduced in proportion to Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and bars recovery entirely if that percentage
exceeds fifty percent.
Second, Defendant asserts proportionate responsibility as to any other person whose negligence contributed to the
occurrence, and requests that the trier of fact designate all responsible parties and apportion responsibility among
them.
Third, Defendant asserts that Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following reasonable medical advice and by
delaying necessary treatment, and that any recovery for mdeical expenses is limited to amounts actually paid or
incurred under Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code Section 41.0105.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
